Bighorn Apiary, LLC

Local honey and hive products from LOCAL hives. All of our bees are raised in Chaffee County and are never transported to others areas of the country. We also build hive woodenware for our use and for local beekeepers. Our wood shop is solar powered, and our commercial kitchen provider where we extract our honey and bottle also utilizes solar energy.
